mapper.sql: Q.QUOTE_ID, Q.OPPTY_ID, Q.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, Q.QUOTE_NM, Q.QUOTE_DT, Q.VALID_DT, Q.TOTAL_AMT, Q.STATUS_CD, Q.CHARGE_USER_ID, Q.REG_DT, Q.UPD_DT
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TB_QUOTE Q LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON C.CUST_ID = Q.CUST_ID WHERE Q.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}

SELECT I.QUOTE_ID, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, I.QTY, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.AMT FROM TB_QUOTE_ITEM I LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE I.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QUOTE (QUOTE_ID, OPPTY_ID, CUST_ID, QUOTE_NM, QUOTE_DT, VALID_DT, TOTAL_AMT, STATUS_CD, CHARGE_USER_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{quoteId}, #{opptyId}, #{custId}, #{quoteNm}, #{quoteDt}, #{validDt}, #{totalAmt}, '10', #{chargeUserId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO TB_QUOTE_ITEM (QUOTE_ID, ITEM_SEQ, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT) VALUES (#{quoteId}, #{itemSeq}, #{productId}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{amt})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUOTE SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId}
